d:
Sonpur mele men 37 ghore lekar pahunche vyapari ikbal anant sinh ke phain nikle.
Ikbal chahte hain ki unhen anant sinh ki ghurdaur res men shamil hone ka mauka mile.
Unhonne kaha ki 6 lakh rupye ka apna ghora anant bhaiya ko 4 lakh rupye men de denge.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
